clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau learned a breathing correction from his own kung fu teacher, Grandmaster Tai: breathe through the nose only, from the diaphragm, not the chest.

Most people breathe shallow without noticing it - chest rising instead of the belly, mouth open instead of nose closed. His fix: put your attention two inches below your belly button, breathe in so the stomach rises, breathe out so it falls.

After watching Kevin practice it for two hours straight, his teacher told him it had already become automatic - 'now habit, now on autopilot.'

How many hours of your own day do you spend breathing through your mouth?
